decisions.reason: As a now-established but still adjacent sensor module within the modular platform, it remains inexpensive to carry and still offers learning value, so we keep the option open unless clearer evidence of weak demand emerges.

The solid state relay module fits tightly with the firm's control and automation architecture and likely has low incremental support cost, so its option value remains higher than the case for withdrawal.

The RGB LED control module is a recent launch with demand still uncertain, and because it builds on the existing modular system we keep it on the market while the firm learns whether it becomes a useful niche complement.

Although the remote access service for wallboxes requires ongoing software support, it is strategically aligned with the firm's expansion in charging and energy management, so we retain it to preserve upside while market acceptance is still being tested.
